review.description: Native Make verification now automatically retains the bounded local journal. Hosted source selection and workflow upload remain in the next slice. Existing product behavior and pinned adoption remain unchanged.
review.implementation: Inspected the exact Make worker entry, worker-native metadata prerequisite, each fixed phase wrapper and unchanged dependency ordering. Native command-line/inherited variables, target-specific comparison, ci override, dry runs, keep-going policy and pipe/FIFO jobserver capabilities retain their existing semantics. The journal and optional descriptor implementation are byte-identical to the preceding core slice; ci.py and hosted workflow remain unchanged.
review.tests: Read the real Make recorder assertions for single shared preparation, command order, failure/unstarted states, actual expanded comparison before work, dry-run no-journal and actual pipe/FIFO jobservers. Real SIGTERM and forced probe-assertion regressions require partial evidence and removed owned commands. Existing runner/cancellation and privacy assertions remain; actual hosted dispatcher and workflow upload assertions follow in the next slice.
